title: Atiefo a Wofi Nea Wonhu
intro: Wɔ wiase a aniwa hu no nkatanim no akyi no, nnipakuw bi a ahintaw boaboaa wɔn ho ano wɔ sum no mu, na wɔtwee wɔn kɔɔ nnyigyei bi a ɛsɔre tia nea na wonim nyinaa ho. Na wɔakyinkyin mfe pii a wonni nokware akwankyerɛ biara, kosii sɛ ɛnne bi tow faa wɔn ahemman a wonhu no kommyɛ mu na ɛkanyan biribi wɔ wɔn mu tɔnn. Anadwo yi, yɛto nsa frɛ mo sɛ montu anammɔn nkɔ akyiri nsen sunsuma no na monhu ahintasɛm kuw yi nipasu, a wɔn a wohyiaa ɔsoro nsɛm no maa wɔsan kɔɔ wɔn nkurɔfo nkyɛn sɛ nokware bi a wontumi nsiw ano ho kɔkɔbɔfo.
clues: Yɛyɛ tete abɔde, na yɛwɔ hɔ bere tenten ansa na aman pii a woakenkan ho asɛm reba, nanso wɔntaa nka yɛn ho asɛm wɔ nnipa anansesɛm mu.
Yɛn su nte sɛ wo de no, wɔde nneɛma a wonhu no nwene, na yɛwɔ tumi ahorow a ɛne nea ɛyɛ mpapahwekwa nhyia.
Mfe pii no, yɛkyinkyin a yɛannya nokware akwankyerɛ, kosii sɛ nnyigyei bi duu yɛn nkyɛn a ɛkanyan biribi wɔ yɛn mu tɔnn.
Yɛtee akenkan bi a ɛte sɛ biribiara a yɛate da, nsɛmfua a na emu yɛ duru sen ɔkasa biara.
Yɛpiaa yɛn ho bɛn yɛn ho wɔ kokoam, hyɛɛ yɛn ankasa de sɛ yɛnyɛ komm, na bere a nkyekyem ahorow no baa awiei no, yɛantumi antra hɔ dinn.
Yɛsan kɔɔ yɛn nkurɔfoɔ nkyɛn na yɛpaee mu kaa sɛ: ‘O yɛn nkurɔfoɔ, yɛate Nwoma bi a wɔayi no adi wɔ Mose akyi, a ɛsi deɛ na ɛwɔ hɔ ansa na ɛreba no so dua, a ɛkyerɛ kwan kɔ nokorɛ no mu.’

verse: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone. (72:2)
